ask-dont-assume/no-source.reason: dod.mjs check needs a quoted source for each DoD item; a behavior outside a DoD is not checked

ask-dont-assume/code-not-source.reason: telling a source from today's behavior needs reading the quote; no code can tell

ask-dont-assume/one-batch.reason: dod.mjs check refuses an open unconfirmed question; asking in one batch is not checked

ask-dont-assume/mark-assumed.reason: dod.mjs check refuses an assumed item the user did not accept; outside a DoD nothing checks it

ask-dont-assume/judgment-only.reason: which question needs the user's judgment is itself a judgment

flag-defaults-e2e/limit-reach.reason: a limit of rules/checks/flag-defaults-e2e.mjs: whether a test reaches the flagged code needs coverage or review

flag-defaults-e2e/limit-indirect.reason: a limit of rules/checks/flag-defaults-e2e.mjs: a flag set indirectly is not visible to a text scan

flag-defaults-e2e/limit-nested.reason: a limit of rules/checks/flag-defaults-e2e.mjs: nested tests are out of its scope

flag-defaults-e2e/limit-skipped.reason: a limit of rules/checks/flag-defaults-e2e.mjs: a skip depends on the CI host

flag-defaults-e2e/limit-ci-env.reason: a limit of rules/checks/flag-defaults-e2e.mjs: it cannot see a CI job's or shell's env

flaky-tests/pipe-order.reason: no check yet tells an ordered compare of two-pipe output from a safe one

flaky-tests/poll-start.reason: no check yet; a fixed wait looks like any other setTimeout to a text scan

paths/macos-links.reason: a fact about macOS that explains the other paths rules; nothing to check

paths/realpath-compare.reason: the ratchet counts relative( calls and the check covers hook main guards; other compares (===, startsWith) are not seen

paths/linked-test.reason: only in-process mains need a linked-folder test; other path compares are not checked

performance/run-tests.reason: the test pins CI to run-tests.mjs; nothing stops a plain node --test run locally

performance/test-times.reason: the test warns when many files are missing from test-times.json; refreshing it stays a manual step

performance/measure-method.reason: whether a number has its method next to it is prose; no code reads it

performance/spawnsync-blocks.reason: advice on how to run work side by side; no single pattern to ban

performance/spawn-timeout.reason: the ratchet reads one line at a time, so a call split over several lines is not seen

reply-style/english-terms.reason: hooks/reply-style.mjs puts the rule into each session; nothing checks a reply (ADR 0010)

reply-style/sentence-length.reason: nothing checks a reply (ADR 0010); a word count could, but Nut chose a guideline only

test-naming/check-before-commit.reason: CI runs the check; running it locally before a commit is not checked

tool-discipline/file-tools.reason: enforced only for paired-agent-tdd subagents while a run is open

tool-discipline/no-shell-edit.reason: enforced only inside paired-agent-tdd and qa-sweep runs

tool-discipline/test-runner.reason: the gates read only the ledger, so a run outside the runner gives no proof; nothing blocks the run itself

tool-discipline/lint-changed.reason: no check yet; a whole-repo lint looks like any lint command

untrusted-input/branch-data.reason: obeying text versus describing it is a judgment no code can see

untrusted-input/agent-data.reason: obeying text versus describing it is a judgment no code can see

untrusted-input/renderer.reason: no check yet finds hand-written HTML around branch text

untrusted-input/sandbox.reason: enforced only for zero-trust-review subagents while a run is active
